title: How is Stalin connected to Optimus Prime?
description:
Seven links connect Joseph Stalin to Optimus Prime, through Mao, two presidents, two movie stars and the voice of the Autobots.

Joseph Stalin → Mao Zedong → Gerald Ford → George H. W. Bush → Robert Redford → Shia LaBeouf → Peter Cullen → Optimus Prime

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
